pets.summary: Small pets are permitted in the cabin under specific conditions; larger animals must travel in the hold.
pets.details: Pets weighing up to 8kg including their carrier may travel in the cabin in an approved soft-sided carrier (max 40x30x20cm). The cabin pet fee is €50 per flight segment. Pets between 8kg and 32kg must travel in the temperature-controlled hold for €120 per segment. Brachycephalic breeds (pugs, bulldogs, boxers, shih tzus) are not permitted in the hold for safety reasons. All pet bookings must be made at least 48 hours before departure and are subject to availability — only two pets per flight in cabin. Certified service animals travel free of charge and do not count toward the cabin pet limit.

baggage.summary: All fares include one cabin bag; hold baggage allowance and excess fees depend on fare class.
baggage.details: Every passenger may bring one cabin bag (up to 8kg, 55x40x20cm) and one personal item (40x30x15cm) free of charge. Hold baggage allowance varies by fare: Economy Light includes no checked bags, Economy includes one 23kg bag, Business includes two 23kg bags. Additional hold bags cost €35 each when added in advance, or €50 at the airport. Bags exceeding 23kg incur an excess fee of €15 per kilogram. Bags larger than 158cm total dimensions are charged €75 as oversized. Add baggage online up to 4 hours before departure for the lowest fee.

special_items.summary: Sports equipment, musical instruments, prams, and mobility aids may be carried with advance notice.
special_items.details: Sports equipment (skis, golf bags, surfboards, bicycles in approved cases) costs €50 per item up to 32kg and must be declared at booking or at least 24 hours before departure. Small musical instruments may be carried as cabin baggage if they fit standard dimensions; larger instruments require an extra seat at €100. Prams and strollers travel free and may be checked at the gate. Wheelchairs travel free; battery-powered chairs require declaration of battery type, with lithium-ion batteries limited to 300 watt-hours.

special_assistance.summary: Passengers with reduced mobility or special needs receive complimentary assistance with advance request.
special_assistance.details: Aegis Airlines provides free assistance for passengers with disabilities or reduced mobility. Standard categories are: WCHR (wheelchair for ramp), WCHS (wheelchair for steps), WCHC (wheelchair for cabin transfer), BLND (blind/visually impaired), DEAF (hearing impaired), MAAS (meet-and-assist), and UMNR (unaccompanied minor). All requests must be made at least 48 hours before departure via the booking system or by calling support. Passengers requiring assistance should arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure to allow time for boarding. Service animals are welcomed free of charge.

check_in.summary: Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure; airport counters close 45 minutes before.
check_in.details: Online check-in opens 24 hours and closes 2 hours before scheduled departure, available via the website, mobile app, or kiosk. Airport check-in counters open 3 hours before departure and close strictly 45 minutes before. Boarding gates open 30 minutes before departure and close 15 minutes before. Passengers arriving after gate closure will be denied boarding regardless of fare class. Mobile boarding passes are accepted at all Aegis-operated airports.

flight_status.summary: Real-time flight status, gate, and delay information is available via the booking system.
flight_status.details: Flight status is available in real time via the website, mobile app, automated SMS for opted-in passengers, and customer service phone. Gate assignments are typically published 60 minutes before departure. Per EU Regulation 261/2004, delays exceeding 3 hours on Aegis-operated flights entitle passengers to compensation: €250 for flights under 1500km, €400 for 1500-3500km, and €600 for over 3500km, subject to extraordinary circumstances exemptions.

cancellation.summary: Refund eligibility and timing depend on fare type and how far in advance the cancellation occurs.
cancellation.details: Bookings cancelled within 24 hours of purchase receive a full refund, provided the flight is at least 7 days away. After this window: Economy Flex and Business Flex fares are fully refundable any time before departure. Standard Economy and Business fares incur a cancellation fee of €75 and €150 respectively, with the remainder refunded. Economy Light is non-refundable but eligible for a credit voucher valid 12 months. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

rescheduling.summary: Bookings may be changed to a different date or flight, with fees depending on fare and timing.
rescheduling.details: Economy Flex and Business Flex bookings may be changed free of charge any time up to 2 hours before departure. Standard Economy changes cost €50, Business changes cost €100. The customer also pays any positive fare difference; if the new fare is cheaper, no refund of the difference is given. Bookings may be changed up to 3 times. After the 2-hour deadline, only same-day standby is possible at the airport, subject to availability.

seating.summary: Seat selection is available at booking, online check-in, or for a fee at the time of selection.

exit_row_restrictions: must be able to assist in evacuation

seating.details: All passengers may select an available seat free of charge during online check-in (24 hours before departure). Pre-assigned seat selection at booking costs €8 for standard seats, €20 for extra legroom rows, and €15 for exit row seats. Exit row seats require passengers to be at least 16 years old, physically able to assist in an emergency evacuation, and without reduced mobility. Business class seats are always pre-assigned at booking with no extra fee.
